title: Exact limits and rationalizations of normalized monodromy towers
statement: Fix the monodromy point, finite correspondence, functor, three lattices with normalizations, and two normalization maps as in [def-sfb-monodromy-realization-data]. Suppose the two maps of etale finite levels form a short exact sequence at every level, and the transitions on the first normalized tower are epimorphisms. Then extension of the prescribed integral maps along the integral-to-field coefficient inclusion is a short exact sequence. This assumes categorical finite-level exactness; it does not identify this sequence from the quotient fibres. The rational composite-zero equation is supplied; the conclusion is short exactness of that actual short complex.

source.place: Definition 6.8.3, Proposition 6.8.4(1),(4),(6), pp. 59–60, and the integral-monodromy reduction in the proof of Corollary 6.8.5, p. 60. The exact-realization formulation makes the comparison used in that proof explicit; it does not assert closure of all pro-étale lisse sheaves.

proof.text: Forget module sheaves to abelian sheaves using the faithful exact functor. Evaluation on weakly contractible pro-etale affines preserves finite limits and epimorphisms, hence finite colimits and short exactness. Epimorphic adjacent kernel transitions induce surjective maps on these sections at every transition. Apply the Mittag-Leffler theorem for countable inverse systems of abelian groups. The weakly contractible affine covering theorem detects the resulting limit epimorphisms locally; kernels and the normalization limit cones identify the actual integral short complex with this inverse-limit sequence. Reflect short exactness through the faithful exact forgetful functor. Apply the separate exact rationalization theorem to the prescribed integral maps.

lean.statement:
theorem sf_monodromy_limit_rational_exact (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type (u + 1)) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] {T : Scheme.{u}} (p : SfMonodromyPoint T)
    (c : GaloisLisseFiniteCorrespondence p.point p.group)
    (J : SfContinuousRepresentations l E p ⥤ SfRationalModules l E T)
    {V W Z : SfContinuousRepresentations l E p} (f : V ⟶ W) (g : W ⟶ Z)
    (C : SfInvariantLattice l E V) (B : SfInvariantLattice l E W)
    (D : SfInvariantLattice l E Z)
    (hCB : ∀ a : C.submodule, f.hom.hom a.val ∈ B.submodule)
    (hBD : ∀ b : B.submodule, g.hom.hom b.val ∈ D.submodule)
    (N : SfLatticeNormalization l E p c J V C)
    (M : SfLatticeNormalization l E p c J W B)
    (P : SfLatticeNormalization l E p c J Z D)
    (F : SfNormalizationMap l E f C B hCB N M)
    (G : SfNormalizationMap l E g B D hBD M P)
    (hfinite : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ w : F.levels.app (op n) ≫ G.levels.app (op n) = 0,
      (ShortComplex.mk (F.levels.app (op n)) (G.levels.app (op n)) w).ShortExact)
    (ht : ∀ n : ℕ, Epi (N.etale.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op))
    (w : SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom
        (ProEtale.lisseIntegerToFieldSized l E T) N.integral F.integral ≫
      SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom
        (ProEtale.lisseIntegerToFieldSized l E T) M.integral G.integral = 0) :
      (ShortComplex.mk
        (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom
          (ProEtale.lisseIntegerToFieldSized l E T) N.integral F.integral)
        (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom
          (ProEtale.lisseIntegerToFieldSized l E T) M.integral G.integral) w).ShortExact
